svg.title: Norm profiles of the quaternionic 840-point model
svg.desc: A triangle whose corners stand for the three quaternionic factors. Each of the 840 points is placed at the share of its squared length in each factor: the three axial 24-cells at the corners, the 384 points of M1 at one half, one quarter, one quarter and the 384 of M2 at one quarter, one half, one quarter. Bars at right give the squared length carried by each factor in total.
